items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Slim Gaillard worked opposite us down there

ctx.x: Well you were used to relying on things and -- and Slim Gaillard worked opposite us down there, but I went along like that for the first week or so, and I was just everynight, I'd go home and think about it and think about it. What do I have to do, what -- I have to solidify the thing.
